guangdong.lead: Guangdong makes about a fifth of China’s goods trade, from phones and servers in Shenzhen to furniture in Foshan and machinery in Jiangmen. This guide summarises the province’s 2025 official figures, links to our city guides and gives short sourced profiles of other manufacturing cities.
guangdong.intro: The Guangdong Provincial Bureau of Statistics’ 2025 bulletin gives the province-wide picture below.
facts: Guangdong’s GDP was 14,584.676 billion yuan in 2025, up 3.9%; value added of industry above designated size grew 3.0%.
Equipment manufacturing made up 59.6% of above-designated-size industrial value added, advanced manufacturing 56.2% and high-tech manufacturing 34.7%.
The province made 1.1829 million new-energy vehicles (+27.7%), 336,300 industrial robot sets (+31.2%), 7.6136 million civilian drones (+39.0%) and 2.9461 million servers (+28.2%).
Goods trade was 9,494.16 billion yuan (+4.4%), 20.9% of China’s total; exports were 6,034.86 billion yuan (+2.5%), of which high-tech products made up 33.6%.
Private firms handled 63.9% of trade, and ports handled 80.9704 million TEU of containers (+4.5%).
guangdong.after: Guangdong’s exporters face a very crowded comparison: a buyer looking for almost any manufactured product will find dozens of Guangdong suppliers. The ones who win are specific — about what they make, the standards they meet and how they ship — and they make that easy to check online.

facts: Jiangmen’s GDP was 429.391 billion yuan in 2025 (+2.8%); its 3,870 industrial firms above designated size grew 3.4%.

Equipment manufacturing reached 35.7% of above-designated-size value added (+13.6%): rail, ship, aerospace and other transport equipment grew 31.9%, general-purpose equipment 13.0% and automobiles 8.6%.

Traditional industries fell 4.8%, including household appliances (−1.1%), furniture (−4.1%) and textiles and clothing (−5.9%). Exports rose 5.0% to 169.17 billion yuan, and trade with Belt and Road countries 8.7%.
smaller.note: Jiangmen’s growth is in equipment, while its appliance, furniture and textile makers are under pressure. For both groups, product pages with real specifications and market-specific certifications are the starting point.

facts: Anhui’s GDP was 5,298.9 billion yuan in 2025, up 5.5%; high-tech manufacturing grew 30.4% and made up 18.1% of above-designated-size industrial value added.
Computer, communication and other electronic equipment grew 40.9% and automobile manufacturing 20.1%.
The province made 3.686 million cars, including 1.794 million new-energy vehicles; the bulletin says both ranked first in China.
Exports were 682.31 billion yuan (+17.8%); vehicle exports reached 1.228 million units (+28.7%), first in China.
Exports of the “new three” — electric vehicles, lithium-ion batteries and solar products — rose 107.8% to 101.83 billion yuan; trade with ASEAN grew 38.3% and with the EU 21.6%.
Strategic emerging industries made up 45.4% of above-designated-size industrial output; integrated-circuit output grew 9.6%, LCD panels 13.6% and microcomputers 20.6%.
anhui.after: Anhui’s exporters are riding a vehicle and battery boom, and their suppliers are following them abroad. Buyers in these supply chains qualify suppliers on quality systems, testing and documentation. A website that shows them clearly is part of the qualification. Electronics is growing alongside vehicles, so component and materials suppliers of many kinds are finding new buyers.

facts: Chuzhou’s value added of industry above designated size grew 7.4% in 2025; electronics grew 14.9%, general-purpose equipment 15.6% and chemicals 11.3%.
The city made 9.634 million kWh of lithium-ion batteries (+143.5%), 20.542 million kW of engines (+19.5%) and 5.376 million refrigerators (−16%).
smaller.note: Chuzhou combines appliances with a fast-growing battery and engine base. Appliance makers should publish model tables and certifications per market; battery suppliers specifications and test reports.

hubei.name: Hubei

hubei.h1: Export websites and Google SEO for Hubei manufacturers
hubei.description: Hubei’s manufacturing cities in official 2025 figures — Wuhan, Xiangyang and Shiyan — and how their exporters win overseas buyers online.
hubei.lead: Hubei makes optical fibre, photonics, electronics and vehicles in Wuhan, and vehicles, parts and batteries in Xiangyang and Shiyan. Its exports rose almost a fifth in 2025, and trade with the EU grew 40%. This guide summarises the official figures and links to our city guide.
hubei.intro: The Hubei Provincial Bureau of Statistics’ 2025 bulletin, as republished on the Qianjiang government portal, gives the figures below.
facts: Hubei’s GDP was 6,266.090 billion yuan in 2025, up 5.5%; value added of industry above designated size grew 6.9%.
High-tech manufacturing grew 15.5% and made up 17.4% of above-designated-size value added; electronics grew 16.9%.
Goods trade was 834.01 billion yuan (+18.2%) and exports 581.86 billion yuan (+19.6%).
Trade with ASEAN, Hubei’s largest partner, was 175.58 billion yuan (+16.7%), and with the EU 113.66 billion yuan (+40.2%).
Trade with Belt and Road countries was 457.61 billion yuan (+21.0%), 54.9% of the total; ports handled 2.7537 million TEU (+5.6%).
The export delivery value of above-designated-size industry rose 9.0%; trade with other RCEP members was 265.95 billion yuan (+15.7%), 31.9% of the total.
hubei.after: Hubei’s exporters grew fast in 2025, especially in Europe and ASEAN. Many are inland suppliers of technical products. Buyers need detailed specifications — and a clear explanation of how goods get from central China to their door. Close to a third of its trade is with other RCEP members, so Asia-Pacific buyers matter as much as Europe.
tiles: of trade with Belt and Road countries

facts: Xiangyang made 284,000 vehicles in 2025 (−4.7%), including 83,000 new-energy vehicles.
Lithium-ion battery output rose 113.1% to 29.296 million kWh and mobile-phone output 57.5% to 5.124 million.
smaller.note: Xiangyang’s car and parts makers face a flat vehicle market while its battery and phone lines grow fast. For both, product pages with real specifications and certifications are the starting point for new buyers.

facts: Shiyan’s GDP was 270.48 billion yuan in 2025, up 6.4%; value added of industry above designated size grew 12.3%.
Automobile manufacturing grew 14.8%, electrical machinery 7.2% and chemicals 13.8%.
smaller.note: In Shiyan, automobile manufacturing grew faster than industry as a whole. Vehicle and parts suppliers there should show quality systems, testing and the vehicle types they serve.

hunan.title: Hunan Manufacturers: Export Websites & SEO | Hurfi
hunan.h1: Export websites and Google SEO for Hunan manufacturers
hunan.description: Hunan’s manufacturing cities in official 2025 figures — Changsha and Zhuzhou — and how their machinery, equipment and vehicle exporters win buyers online.
hunan.lead: Hunan makes construction machinery and equipment in Changsha and Zhuzhou, and its car output grew almost a third in 2025. Exports dipped, with a sharp fall to the United States, while ASEAN grew. This guide summarises the official figures and links to our city guide.
hunan.intro: The Hunan Provincial Bureau of Statistics’ 2025 bulletin gives the figures below.
facts: Hunan’s GDP was 5,530.87 billion yuan in 2025, up 4.8%; value added of industry above designated size grew 6.2%.
Equipment manufacturing grew 8.6% and made up 33.9% of above-designated-size value added; high-tech manufacturing grew 11.2%.
The province made 44,000 units of concrete machinery (+39.6%) and 1.626 million cars (+30.8%).
Exports were 320.76 billion yuan (−4.1%); mechanical and electrical exports rose 2.0% to 187.47 billion yuan.
Exports to ASEAN rose 5.5% to 63.28 billion yuan and to the EU 0.4% to 32.72 billion, while exports to the United States fell 29.2% to 22.27 billion.
Private firms made 64.5% of above-designated-size industrial value added; processing-trade exports rose 21.1% to 54.09 billion yuan while general-trade exports fell 7.8%.
hunan.after: Hunan’s machinery and rail makers sell big, engineered products, often into infrastructure projects in emerging markets. Buyers compare specifications, service and references. A website that shows them clearly supports every tender and dealer conversation. Most of its industry is private, and many of these firms are now looking for direct overseas buyers.

henan.lead: Henan makes electronics, electrical equipment and vehicles in Zhengzhou, equipment in Luoyang, and wigs and hair products in Xuchang. Its exports grew 18% in 2025. This guide summarises the official figures and links to our city guide.
henan.intro: The Henan Provincial Bureau of Statistics’ 2025 bulletin, as republished by ifeng.com, gives the figures below.
facts: Henan’s GDP was 6,663.279 billion yuan in 2025, up 5.6%; value added of industry above designated size grew 8.4%.
Electrical machinery grew 20.8%, metal products 15.5%, automobiles 14.7% and electronics 14.1%; high-tech manufacturing grew 16.6%.
Integrated-circuit output rose 71.0% and lithium-ion batteries 53.8%; car output passed 1.5 million.
Goods trade was 935.673 billion yuan (+14.1%) and exports 616.818 billion yuan (+18.0%).
Key industrial chains made up 63.9% of above-designated-size industry and grew 9.5%.
New-generation information technology grew 20.3% and the new-energy vehicle industry 17.6%; food manufacturing grew 15.1% and agricultural and food processing 12.7%.
henan.after: Henan’s exporters range from electronics assemblers to heavy-equipment makers and specialist consumer-goods makers. What they share is a need to be found and trusted by buyers far away. Specific product pages and honest proof do that better than broad claims. Its food and agricultural processing industries also grew fast, a large export base often overlooked online.

sichuan.lead: Sichuan builds computers, displays and aerospace parts in Chengdu and power-generation equipment in Deyang, and its battery and car output grew fast in 2025. Almost half its trade is processing trade. This guide summarises the official figures and links to our city guide.
sichuan.intro: The Sichuan Provincial Bureau of Statistics’ 2025 bulletin, as published by Sichuan Daily’s Chuanguan News, gives the figures below.
facts: Sichuan’s GDP was 6,766.53 billion yuan in 2025, up 5.5%; value added of industry above designated size grew 6.5%.
Automobile manufacturing grew 16.7%, electrical machinery 13.2%, electronics 12.9% and chemicals 12.8%; high-tech manufacturing grew 12.3%.
Output of smart TVs rose 72.7%, lithium-ion batteries 45.1%, cars 29.6% and LCD panels 21.6%.
Goods trade was 1,031.81 billion yuan (−1.3%) and exports 608.65 billion yuan (−1.5%).
Processing trade was 490.44 billion yuan (+3.1%), 47.5% of trade; general trade 34.5%.
33 of 41 industry groups grew; value added of foreign-invested firms rose 13.7%.
sichuan.after: Many Sichuan exports are processing trade for global brands. For the province’s own-brand and component makers, winning direct buyers means showing technical depth — and explaining logistics from western China clearly. Foreign-invested manufacturing grew fastest, and suppliers to those plants can use the same evidence to reach buyers abroad.

Revenue of above-designated-size industry was 455.08 billion yuan (+1.7%), but profits fell 9.8%.
smaller.note: Deyang makes heavy power-generation equipment, and its output grew strongly in 2025. Its suppliers sell on standards, type tests and delivered projects; a website should show all three.
